function #minecraft:load
gamerule spawn_phantoms
gamerule players_sleeping_percentage
team list
scoreboard objectives list
bossbar list
function multiplayer_sleep:config
gamerule send_command_feedback
setblock 5 201 5 minecraft:glass
setblock 6 201 5 minecraft:red_stained_glass
setblock 7 201 5 minecraft:stone
execute if block 5 201 5 #minecraft:does_not_block_hoppers run say GLASS_OK
execute if block 6 201 5 #minecraft:does_not_block_hoppers run say STAINED_OK
execute if block 7 201 5 #minecraft:does_not_block_hoppers run say STONE_WRONGLY_IN_TAG
execute if block 7 201 5 #minecraft:does_not_block_hoppers
datapack list enabled
